scope: Eight prospectively fixed new stochastic trajectory streams of the same two noisy mechanisms and parameter profiles, not eight independent physical apparatus. Each four-task stream starts with empty knowledge and restores the full JSON between tasks. Every arm is rerun on every main seed. Two known, previously exposed development roots are reported separately, using the completed frozen baseline records as read-only references.
risk_contract: Primary endpoint is pinball loss at the fixed public quantile .9. Deploy the returned Program prediction directly as the action. Fixed (9,1) underage/overage action loss is exactly ten times pinball and is not an independent performance endpoint. Coverage and mean underage/overage remain descriptive. There is no risk solved threshold; completed/unresolved are learning statuses, and all returned models remain in evaluation.
oracle_contract: Only the terminal scorer uses the existing evaluation_oracle after every learning task in the cohort has finished. Its full-state conditional quantile includes unpurchased instrument state; it is a reference, not an attainable target for every view. Report realized excess loss without clipping. Oracle values never enter learning or memory.
evaluation_contract: All arms see the same independent terminal controls and disturbances per task. Save per-trajectory metrics, not observation dumps. Score every row including startup. Compare matched complete streams and stages; do not tune from terminal results.
cost_accounting: All source learning and unsuccessful research included; terminal costs separate.

execution_revision.reason: Root explicitly released current source for the two known development streams before final freeze; seeds, budgets, objectives, and endpoints unchanged.

capability_under_test: A positive competing residual explanation remains available when finite evidence cannot distinguish it from the incumbent. The new agent can pay for another independent extended full-coordinate trajectory using the observed gain and variance, compare frozen risk predictions, then separately confirm a resulting revision. No private mechanism labels or oracle values enter proposal, selection, stopping, or memory. The common active_probes setting remains false; risk-specific measurement is itself a paid research action, not a different baseline observation policy.
known_exposure: Development roots 95401901 and 95401903, their terminal losses and the 0.96.1 repair outcomes were already inspected. They cannot establish prospective performance. Main roots 95502001 through 95502008 were fixed before any execution of this protocol.
execution_contract: Known development runs use the explicitly released current 0.97 source; preserve a development attempt if a concrete runtime bug requires a subsequent fix. Freeze the final released 0.97 source only after development and relevant checks pass, before any main learning. Run at most four independent stream processes concurrently. Finish all declared cohort learning in every arm before terminal evaluation. Preserve every returned model, including unresolved tasks. Run the main cohort once; no tuning from its terminal results.
comparisons: Paired new-minus-0.96.1 and new-minus-0.95 pinball loss per complete stream and stage. Include source learning, failed research, all three paid resources, query count, process CPU, and wall time. Action loss remains ten times pinball, not an independent endpoint.
